name: Blindfold Focus
text: Apply a soft, clean, easily removable blindfold. Allow time to become comfortable with reduced visual input. Notice ordinary sounds, breathing and gentle touch. The giver should explain any changes in activity when advance warning is part of the agreed protocol.
safetyNote: Never apply pressure to eyes. No walking/balance activities while blindfolded. Keep blindfold easy to remove. Stop immediately if panic develops.

phases.name: SETTLE
phases.prompt: Apply blindfold only after consent. Become comfortable with reduced visual input.

phases.name: SENSORY_AWARENESS
phases.prompt: Notice sounds, breathing, gentle touch. Giver explains activity changes.

phases.name: CHECK_IN
phases.prompt: Confirm comfort and willingness to continue.

phases.name: RETURN
phases.prompt: Remove blindfold and allow time to readjust.

name: Quiet Focus
text: Agree on a visual or tactile stop signal before reducing auditory input. Keep face and airway unobstructed. Use comfortable, removable hearing protection or quiet environment. Do not use sound restriction if it prevents reliable safety communication.
safetyNote: Do not assume safewords will be heard. No earplugs/headphones that prevent communication. Never increase sound levels to compensate. A sensory restriction must never disable the stop mechanism.

phases.name: PREPARE
phases.prompt: Review stop signal. Confirm both understand it.

phases.name: QUIET_INTERVAL
phases.prompt: Reduce background noise. Focus on breathing, comfort, sensations.

phases.name: CHECK_IN
phases.prompt: Restore communication or use agreed signal to confirm comfort.

phases.name: RESTORE_HEARING
phases.prompt: Remove protection and check in verbally.

name: Texture Contrast
text: Prepare 2-3 clean materials with clearly different textures (soft cotton, smooth satin, microfiber). Introduce each texture separately. Alternate between materials, allowing a pause between changes. Ask which textures to continue with, change, or exclude.
safetyNote: Avoid abrasive materials, sharp edges, rough friction. Check allergies. No unfamiliar materials on irritated/injured/numb skin. Emphasize variation, not intensity.

phases.name: FAMILIARIZE
phases.prompt: Introduce each texture separately. Identify comfortable sensations.

phases.name: CONTRAST
phases.prompt: Alternate materials, pause between changes.

phases.name: PREFERENCE_CHECK
phases.prompt: Which textures to continue, change, or exclude?

phases.name: RESET
phases.prompt: Return to familiar texture or stop touching.

name: Gentle Temperature Contrast
text: Use room-temperature material and mildly cool material. Test both on your own skin first. Avoid extreme temperatures, heated implements, and prolonged direct contact with ice. Introduce neutral temperature, then briefly cool contrast, return to baseline.
safetyNote: Do not use extreme heat/cold. Never leave ice on one spot until numb. Avoid on areas with reduced sensation or impaired circulation. Stop for pain, numbness, unusual color, persistent discomfort. Extreme cold can damage tissue even when sensation is misleading.

phases.name: BASELINE
phases.prompt: Introduce neutral-temperature material. Establish comfortable baseline.

phases.name: COOL_CONTRAST
phases.prompt: Briefly introduce mildly cool material. Keep moving. Check comfort.

phases.name: RETURN_BASELINE
phases.prompt: Return to neutral temperature or stop contact.

phases.name: CHECK_IN
phases.prompt: Another gentle contrast, longer rest, or end exercise?

name: Combined Sensory Focus
text: Agree on boundaries, activities, stop signals. Use comfortable blindfold. Reduce background noise without preventing communication. Keep participant comfortably supported, free to move. Do not use restraints or gag.
safetyNote: Keep stop mechanism available. No added restrictions without fresh agreement. Stop if disoriented, distressed, or unable to communicate. Silence/stillness ≠ consent. Allow immediate end.

phases.name: ORIENTATION
phases.prompt: Explain setup. Confirm participant comfortable.

phases.name: SENSORY_FOCUS
phases.prompt: Reduce visual/auditory input. Use only agreed gentle touch.

phases.name: RESTORE_COMMUNICATION
phases.prompt: Remove hearing restriction. Check comfort before proceeding.

phases.name: REMOVE_BLINDFOLD
phases.prompt: Restore vision. Allow time to readjust.

phases.name: DEBRIEF
phases.prompt: What felt comfortable? What should change? Want to finish?
